# Vendored SyncTeX parser

The files in this directory are copied without functional changes from
`jlaurens/synctex` commit `04cf8e3e8665ff203248d7af78ee1129afbc1b64`.
They are used by the bounded forward-query helper in
`engine/checkpoint/synctex-batch.js`.
